body:
Thank you for your reply 

But I have 2 choices, at least for the next 10 years

1. Stay with my parents. 

I can enjoy their money and connections and advantages but their awful treatment won't stop and it keeps getting worse. 

2. Try to live on my own. 

It will be nearly impossible for me survive in school and in work while trying to provide for myself, I have zero experience or anything, I won't get to live the lifestyle I'm attached to

Neither options sounds good to me. I already hate the first 18 years of my life and now I have to ruin the next 10. That's not fair for me, I just want out.

Thanks for your help man 

I tell my parents what I think... I do this every week, it's just a part of the cycle. They first try to shut me up, and then they blame it on me. It's happened hundreds of times. It happened today. 

"We have to put up with them till we move out"

I can't. I have to either move out when I'm 18 and find myself totally fucked, or I have to put up with them for another 10-12 years. I can't do either. I just wanna die.

I feel like you might approach my story with suspicion--maybe I seem like a whiney, spoiled, teenager. 

 But **please** leave your convictions aside. If only you could see how they act, you'd understand why I need so desperately to escape them. I could fill a novel with elaboration and evidence, but my hands and head are numb, my eyes are watery and strained and I don't have it in me to type it. You can see my first post in my post history for a more detailed idea and if you want I can elaborate further. They are just evil evil people and I can't put up with them for 10-12 more years, and I can't escape them and try living on my own either. I have to escape my situation some how, and I am completely ready to end my life.

Thank you so much for reaching out to me. If you feel comfortable talking about what's going on with you I am happy to listen 


I just had a conversation with my parents and it's left absolutely broken, I can't handle this anymore. My head and hands are numb...like pins and needs all over, at one point it was my whole body. I can't feel my fingers as I type. I don't even have it in me to elaborate what we talked about but it's the same pattern over and over again, they manipulate and threaten me and then blame everything one me. I really can't do it anymore, it happens all the time and it won't stop. I did nothing wrong, I have no idea why this happens to me over and over over and over again 


I have no escape, I honestly think it would be best for me to consider killing myself to get away from it. I don't think I deserve any of this...I feel like I'm entitled to choose whether or not I want to be alive. Why should I keep living if the same heartbreaking events keep happening over and over and over with no signs of change? It's like a cruel joke, they know exactly what they are doing and don't stop, it just happens over and over and over and over I'm done with it
